questions.question: Why save %dl first?
options: BIOS passes boot drive once; clobbered later
questions.explanation: int calls clobber; drive number needed for int13.

questions.question: Why far jump, not near?
options: Reloads CS hidden cache (else keeps 16-bit decode)
questions.explanation: PE set but CS stale: near jump executes 32-bit bytes as 16-bit.

questions.question: A20 gate does what?
questions.explanation: PC-AT fossil: disabled A20 wraps memory at 1 MiB.

questions.question: -ffreestanding means?
options: No libc/host: kernel provides all (ENTRY replaces _start)
questions.explanation: Freestanding: no main, no syscalls, just your code.

questions.question: After the jump, BIOS is?
options: Unreachable (your segments now): write VGA directly
questions.explanation: int10 needs real mode: kmain writes 0xB8000 cells.

questions.question: LOAD_SECTORS via --defsym because?
options: Kernel size varies: build measures, loader obeys
questions.explanation: Stat counts kernel.bin; assemble bakes the count.
